chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Sayf ibn Umayrah, I have transmitted it from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Sayf, from his brother al-Husayn [ibn Sayf], from their father Sayf ibn Umayrah al-Nakha'i.

key_terms.أَخِيهِ: His brother; indicates the familial link within the chain.
key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Al-Saffar, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.النَّخَعِيِّ: Al-Nakha'i; a tribal or lineage attribution identifying Sayf ibn Umayrah.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement identifying the author’s route of transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Sayf ibn Umayrah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Sayf ibn Umayrah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving hadith provenance within Shia hadith scholarship.
